title: Ocean Waves
description: A swell carries energy across whole oceans with almost none lost: in deep water each metre of wave front carries ρg²H²T/64π watts, tens of kilowatts in an ordinary sea. A float tuned to the swell's period rides it hardest. Unlocks the Wave Energy Converter.

puzzle.goal: A deep-water swell of height H and period T carries its energy at the group speed. Per metre of wave front, the power is ρg²H²T over 64π. Write P.
puzzle.name: Wave power
puzzle.ask: Find P in W per metre of crest: ρ = @{ρ} kg/m³, g = @{g} m/s², H = @{H} m, T = @{T} s.
puzzle.method: Energy per area ρgH²/8, carried at the deep-water group speed gT/4π.
